article.story: SEATTLE -- — Mason Williams and Will Heimbrodt scored 18 points apiece as Seattle University beat Portland State 79-60 on Saturday. Williams had six rebounds and Heimbrodt five for the Redhawks (1-1). Halvine Dzellat had 13 points and eight rebounds. Yaroslav Nikonov finished with 16 points for the Vikings (1-1). Jaquay Randolph added 10 points and 10 rebounds for Portland State. Luke Kearney also had seven points. The game was tied 28-28 at halftime. Seattle U took a nine-point lead in the second half thanks to a 12-0 scoring run. Heimbrodt led the Redhawks in scoring with 13 points. Up next These two teams both play Wednesday. Seattle U hosts UTSA and Portland State visits Colorado State. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
